\[ \text{Lower Limit} = \text{Mean} - 1.96 \times \frac{\text{SD}}{\sqrt{n}} \]

Where \( n = 100 \), so the formula simplifies to:

\[ \text{Lower Limit} = 30 - 1.96 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{100}} = 30 - 1.96 \times 0.1 = 30 - 0.196 = 29.804 \]
